# R5 local hybrid, measured. Deltas from the hip pose: dF forward, dR right, dU up in game units (camera fixed), dPitch dYaw degrees of the sight->muzzle line, progress = 1 - dist(sight, ADS spot) / dist(hip, ADS spot) (negative = further than at hip), normR = dR / total dR. n = frames over 4 runs. +-1 frame of lag against zf.
